title.name: Study the greats: case studies and pattern recognition

overview.description: A gap the programme review flagged explicitly: most accelerators skip this, and 5050 does not. Reverse-engineering companies that worked, and companies that did not, is cheaper than learning the same lessons live.
objectives: Reconstruct how a company you admire actually got its first customer and first cheque
Identify the decision that made it, not the narrative told afterwards
Recognise the failure patterns that most resemble your own position
prerequisites: Orientation: how to read this tree

steps.intro: A gap the programme review flagged explicitly: most accelerators skip this, and 5050 does not. Reverse-engineering companies that worked, and companies that did not, is cheaper than learning the same lessons live.
instructions: Pick two companies in your space: one that worked, one that did not.
Reconstruct the first 24 months of each from primary sources — filings, interviews, archived sites.
Write the one decision that separated them. Then ask whether you are about to make the wrong version of it.

submission.description: No named deliverable. Work the steps and keep the notes with the module in Homeroom.
